descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. That’s what drives us. We are looking for a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) at Roche Diagnostics to serve as key business partner to the commercial organization and report to Finance Enterprise Partner Lead. As a FEP, you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner), to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey. Key Responsibilities
• You partner with the business and support or co-lead touchpoints alongside the customer journey with an enterprise mindset.
• You balance resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.
• You are a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy as well as commercial business related processes such as business planning, opportunity prioritization and creative strategies for revenue generation.
• You ensure financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.
• You participate in FEP communities to learn, share and implement best practices across markets.
• You support the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency. Who You Are
• You possess advanced controlling and reporting skills and expertly manage SAP Finance, as well as BO Analysis and/ or BEx Analyzer and Tableau Software.
• You have an entrepreneurial, commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.
• You have strong business and financial acumen and experience working with and for the customer.
• You are actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• You are able to navigate a complex, challenging environment based on agile principles.
• You are fluent in English and Turkish. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
